fact: RURA's annual report 2020-2021 shows Rwanda's Universal Access and Service Fund, set up by Presidential Order n. 05/01 of 15/03/2004 and paid for by public operators' contributions, collected Frw 5,301,355,698 and spent Frw 3,828,837,334 in FY2020/21, 91% of it on telecommunications towers in underserved areas.
Budget tables: the budget for 2026/27 gives 92,074,979,130 RWF to 38 digital line(s). Dated by the budget document.

Budget tables: the 34 digital line(s) held in both years total 90,624,439,159 RWF for 2026/27 against 87,083,989,612 for 2025/26, +4.1 per cent; 38 lines are held for 2026/27. Dated by the budget document.

RURA Board Decision N 03/BD/ICT/RURA/2024 sets Universal Access Fund contributions on annual turnover, at 2% for network infrastructure and network services licensees and 0.5% for ISP retailers and postal licensees, under Presidential Order 025/01 of 2023.
